cases.note: The loop replicates the original if/else chain exactly: same thresholds checked in descending order (PB→TB→GB→MB→KB) with 'B' as the fallback, so behaviour is identical.

The explicit-integer pattern for the core int tag changed from [-+]?0b... to [^-+]?0b..., so explicitly tagged negative/positive binary literals like '!!int "-0b11"' now fail to resolve, whereas the original build accepted them.
